dedupe_keys.name: digital decade desi indicators eu country data on fibre vhcn and 5g coverage and broadband take up european commission

description: The Digital Decade DESI visualisation tool is the European Commission's data service for the Digital Economy and Society Index and the 2030 Digital Decade targets. The DESI 2026 group holds 59 indicators for the 27 member states and the EU total, across digital skills, digital infrastructure, digitalisation of business and digital public services. Its connectivity indicators include fibre to the premises coverage (2017 to 2025), fixed very high capacity network coverage (2019 to 2025), overall 5G coverage (2020 to 2025) and 5G coverage in the 3.4 to 3.8 GHz band (2022 to 2025). They come from the Broadband Coverage in Europe studies by Omdia and Point Topic, succeeded from 2026 by the Connectivity Coverage in Europe study by Grant Thornton and LS telcom, with data provided and checked by national regulators. Take-up of at least 100 Mbps and 1 Gbps fixed broadband (2017 to 2022) is collected by the Commission through the Communications Committee (COCOM), with a reference date of 1 July each year. Other groups hold the DESI series to 2022 and the EU trajectories to 2030. Coverage: EU27 by country, mostly annual from 2017. Format and access: interactive charts and a public JSON and CSV API for indicator metadata, data sources, countries and facts, free under the European Union Public Licence as stated by the tool. Caveats: values are national, with rural splits for some indicators but no regional or NUTS breakdown in the tool; methods change between study contracts; the underlying study reports sit on the Commission's digital-strategy site, which redirected automated requests. Simulation uses: national fibre and 5G coverage baselines and targets for EU scenario models. Related records: the OECD broadband and telecom databases and the ITU ICT statistics give wider international series; the Eurobarometer e-Communications household surveys give user-side views.
